title: 第23章 对珍贵的女孩子就要吻手礼

第23章 对珍贵的女孩子就要吻手礼-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》

既然魏知弦也明白，秦夙现在不想谈。

他还要选在此刻来见她，肯定还有其他事要说。

秦夙跟他一起下楼，去小花园里的秋千上坐着聊了一会儿。

果然。

魏知弦要跟海莉一起，去污染区支援离颂他们了。

“一早收到离队的消息，那片区域的迷雾太强，他们四个都是哨兵，在里面出现了几次幻觉，需要我和海莉的能力。”

看看，又是秦夙听不懂的话。

她脑袋里的问号都要从眼珠子里蹦出来了。

魏知弦的发色和眸子，在阳光下，蓝色盖过了黑色。

那双眸子随着认真交代的话语，就定定的注视着秦夙，发现她的困惑小表情，懵懂的很可爱。

他嘴角弯了弯，语气不自觉变得更加柔和，“我的作战能力不是队员中最强的，但至今为止，我在污染区还没有被幻觉左右过的经历。至于海莉，她虽然不能像你一样用精神力和向导素安抚哨兵，却可以使用其他精神类技能，把哨兵们脑中被污染侵蚀出的幻觉击碎。”

“啊~”秦夙恍然大悟，“懂了，嗯，很强。”

她竖起个大拇指，“你是队伍里最冷静的人，海莉……”

海莉跟离颂小队，也确实羁绊很深。

否则不会魏知弦一早收到消息，叫她同往，她就能痛快的一口答应下来。

魏知弦不知道秦夙在琢磨什么，稍微低头凑近些，“有什么要问我的吗？”

那还真有。

“海莉走了的话，尤来亚和诺亚怎么整？”秦夙指指通天塔的方向，“诺亚不是已经暴走好些天了么，尤来亚后来怎么说的？”

“尤来亚也在疏导中心的白噪音室里关禁闭，海莉早上告诉我，他在今天凌晨也开始暴走了。”

“是哦。”秦夙对这俩人的情况并不关心，她接着问，“海莉不用管他俩的吗？”

魏知弦沉默片刻，“嗯，她不想管，况且首席向导已经批准海莉随我前去支援离队，对那两个人，白塔的态度也有些消极。”

尤来亚和诺亚虽然犯错，但也是厉害的哨兵，也是白塔的战略资源。

白塔为啥要消极？

哎，又听不懂了。

秦夙叹口气，从秋千上站起，转身面朝魏知弦伸出右手，“一路平安，祝你们毫发无损，凯旋而归。”

魏知弦看看秦夙的手，“这是？”

Chapter 23: Give a precious girl a kiss on the hand - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"

Since Wei Zhixian also understood that Qin Su didn't want to talk about it now.

He still chose this moment to see her, there must be other things to say.

Qin Su went downstairs with him and sat on the swing in the small garden to chat for a while.

really.

Wei Zhixian is going to the contaminated area with Haili to support Li Song and the others.

"I received the news of leaving the team early in the morning. The fog in that area was too strong. The four of them were sentinels. They had several hallucinations inside, which required Hailey and my abilities."

Look, it's something Qin Su doesn't understand again.

The questions in her head were about to pop out of her eyes.

Wei Zhixian's hair color and eyes, in the sunlight, blue overshadowed the black.

Those eyes followed Qin Su's serious words and stared at Qin Su, finding her confused expression, so ignorant and cute.

The corners of his mouth curved, and his tone became softer unconsciously, "My combat ability is not the strongest among the team members, but so far, I have never been affected by hallucinations in the contaminated area. As for Hailey, although she can't use mental power and guide elements to appease the sentries like you, she can use other mental skills to shatter the hallucinations eroded by pollution in the sentinels' minds."

"Ah~" Qin Su suddenly realized, "I understand, um, very strong."

She gave a thumbs up, "You are the calmest person in the team, Hailey..."

Hailey and the Lisong team do have a deep bond.

Otherwise, Wei Zhixian would not have received the message early in the morning, asking her to go with him, and she would have readily agreed.

Wei Zhixian didn't know what Qin Su was thinking about, so he lowered his head and leaned closer, "Do you have anything to ask me?"

That really does exist.

"If Haili leaves, what will happen to Uriah and Noah?" Qin Su pointed in the direction of the Babel Tower, "Isn't Noah already running rampant for several days? What did Uriah say later?"

"Ulea is also in confinement in the white noise room of the isolation center. Hailey told me in the morning that he also started going berserk in the early hours of this morning."

"Yes." Qin Su didn't care about the situation of the two of them. She then asked, "Hai Li doesn't need to worry about them?"

Wei Zhixian was silent for a moment, "Well, she doesn't want to worry about it. Besides, the chief guide has approved Haili to accompany me to support the departure team. Baita's attitude towards those two people is also somewhat negative."

Although Uriah and Noah made mistakes, they were also powerful sentinels and strategic resources of the White Tower.

Why should Baita be negative?

Oops, I don’t understand again.

Qin Su sighed, stood up from the swing, turned to face Wei Zhixian and stretched out his right hand, "Have a safe trip, I wish you all unscathed and return in triumph."

Wei Zhixian looked at Qin Su's hand, "What is this?"
